content.short: SundaeSwap is the sweetest decentralized exchange on Cardano and aiming to be the platform for future financial.
content.description: The SundaeSwap governance platform is both technically elegant and easy to use. SundaeSwap are the early adopters you are looking for: spearheading new technologies on Cardano, while getting things done. Pi also took the time to discuss the new design in Aiken not only with developers, but also the entire Mehen team as a means of educating them of why design changes are being made. SundaeSwap is the first true AMM DEX built on Cardano. The sweetest protocol builders on the blockchain We conceptualize, design and build innovative, decentralized software to power the next generation of global financial services.
